summary: Backend-only iteration 5. 66/66 pytest cases pass against public EXPO_BACKEND_URL (54 regression + 12 new iteration-5). Verified GET /api/live/aathman-channel returns exact contract: channel_id='UCkDostBKd39l9lz8UxpSxBg', handle='@Aathmanawarenesscentre', streams_url contains '/@Aathmanawarenesscentre/streams', live_embed_url contains 'embed/live_stream?channel=UCkDostBKd39l9lz8UxpSxBg', and channel_url is populated. Verified live_sessions migration: every row returned by GET /api/live/sessions has youtube_channel_id=='UCkDostBKd39l9lz8UxpSxBg' and legacy 'youtube_id' field is completely absent. Verified GET /api/live/sessions?kind=satsang and ?kind=yoga each return >=2 rows all pointing to the Aathman channel. Verified POST /api/live/attend: first call awards 100 points, second call is idempotent (already_attended=true, no points added). Full regression still green: auth (send-otp/verify-otp/emergent-session error paths/me), community/info, /api/books (9 Brahmatheerth issues), /api/stats/me points+breakdown+rules, /api/mood/monthly-stats, /api/diary CRUD+dates, /api/rank all scopes, meditations/mantra/music/sleep/QA/SOS/guruji-image migration, orders (MOCKED razorpay). MOCKED: Razorpay verify auto-succeeds; SendGrid replaced by dev_otp when OTP_DEV_MODE=true.

minor.issue: Endpoint is unauthenticated — fine for a public embed URL, but consider adding basic rate-limiting so it can't be scraped in a loop. Also no CDN cache headers set; response is fully static and could set Cache-Control: public, max-age=3600.

live_embed_url hard-codes autoplay=1&playsinline=1 — this is fine on mobile web but many browsers block autoplay without muted=1. Consider adding &mute=1 (or exposing an unmuted variant) so the embed actually starts playing in Chrome/Safari without user tap.
(Carried) File is now 1225 lines; still past the 700-line guideline. Split into routers (auth, points, content, commerce, community, live).
(Carried) No unique compound index on {user_id, session_id} — race window on rapid double-tap could still double-insert.
(Carried) dev_otp is returned whenever SendGrid send fails, not strictly when OTP_DEV_MODE=true.
(Carried) Pydantic v1 body.dict(); migrate to body.model_dump(exclude_none=True).

action_items: None blocking — /api/live/aathman-channel endpoint contract matches spec and live_sessions migration is complete (youtube_channel_id set, youtube_id removed).

Optional polish: (1) add &mute=1 to live_embed_url so browsers actually autoplay the YouTube embed; (2) add Cache-Control on /api/live/aathman-channel (fully static payload); (3) address carried-over items — split server.py, add live_attend unique compound index, gate dev_otp strictly on OTP_DEV_MODE, migrate to Pydantic v2 model_dump.

Frontend testing was out of scope. When embedding the YouTube live_stream URL in the Satsang tab, verify it renders inside a WebView (React Native) or iframe (web) with allow='autoplay' and correct aspect ratio (16:9); also add testID on the video container.
critical_code_review_comments: /api/live/aathman-channel (server.py:684-693) is a clean static endpoint returning the exact fields specified. Uses module-level constants AATHMAN_YOUTUBE_CHANNEL_ID and AATHMAN_YOUTUBE_STREAMS_URL (server.py:994-995), which is good — single source of truth.

live_sessions migration (server.py:1200-1207) runs on startup: $set youtube_channel_id + $unset youtube_id on all rows. Idempotent and safe to re-run. Seed data (server.py:1070-1085) already uses youtube_channel_id so new installs are consistent.
GET /api/live/sessions excludes _id via projection (server.py:677) — good, no ObjectId leaks. datetime->iso conversion done for start_at.
server.py has crossed 1225 lines. Splitting into routers is now overdue.
